prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Edit the provided VIGINTI portrait cabinet concept. Preserve the first-person robot space casino fiction, tight camera crop, red/cream/blue worn chunky low-poly cabinet, restrained warm orange lighting, subtle pixelated texture treatment, and physical bottom buttons HAND SCORES, STAND, DECK with only fingertips visible. Keep 9:16 portrait. Completely REPLACE the overly large cards and dense screen composition using the specification below. This is concept art only.

CRITICAL NEW CARD DESIGN, applies to EVERY face-up card, including dealer and draw cards:
Warm ivory rectangular cards, ratio 5:7, entirely BLANK CENTER. NO CENTRAL SUIT SYMBOL. NO CENTRAL PIPS. NO CENTRAL NUMBER. No face illustration. The ONLY printed information is a bold rank with a compact suit DIRECTLY BELOW it in the UPPER LEFT CORNER, duplicated and rotated 180 degrees in the LOWER RIGHT CORNER. Both rank and suit form one narrow vertical index strip. Use a large readable corner index relative to the card. The remaining 75 percent of card face is plain ivory. On the rightmost exposed card the whole blank center and lower-right upside-down corner must clearly be visible. Do not repeat the old central giant suit.

TIGHT OVERLAP:
Each next card covers approximately 78 percent of the previous card width, exposing ONLY the previous card's narrow upper-left rank-and-suit strip. Seven cards therefore make a compact bundle about 2.3 card widths across. Very shallow fan rotation: at most +/-6 degrees for the whole hand, NOT dramatic splayed card arcs. Keep the card faces the same scale across dealer, draw, and player hands. Seven-card hand occupies about 38 percent of usable screen width, centered, with large negative space both sides. Every exposed rank AND its suit below must be readable. DO NOT spread the hands across screen width. DO NOT enlarge single exposed cards to fill empty space.

SCREEN COMPOSITION:
- Slim single header near top: CASH $250, ROUND 3, ANTE $50. One line, no giant scoreboard box.
- Immediately BELOW header a single shared upper gameplay area: RELICS on LEFT, compact DEALER in CENTRE, CHALLENGES on RIGHT. No information band above dealer. These three elements align at the top.
  LEFT 30 percent width: small simple relic icons to LEFT of readable names, six tight list rows: Star Bead, Heart Button, Lucky Acorn, Faded Tag, Mini Shoe, Cozy Socks. A plain quiet list, no frame, no medallions.
  CENTRE 30 percent: label DEALER, then one face-down card underneath with one face-up 9-spades overlapping most of it and offset right by only one index-strip width. The dealer's face-up card covers most of the underlying face-down card. Not two separate cards side-by-side. Small "9" total below. Dealer is at TOP of the playfield, not pushed down beneath relics.
  RIGHT 30 percent: compact heading CHALLENGES then three rows reading exactly "Rounds 2/4", "Pairs 1/4", "Flushes 2/8". Each has its small simple challenge icon on the FAR RIGHT after its text and numbers. Right aligned text; icon at the row's right edge. No progress bars, no descriptions, no boxes, no large circles. Leave visible horizontal gaps separating all three columns.
- Leave a comfortable blank blue gap BELOW this upper gameplay area.
- A restrained DRAW area centered below: a shallow low-profile tray about 55 percent screen width, with THREE SMALL card positions. Left face-up 2 clubs with blank center and proper mirrored corner indices; centre 4 diamonds half way through a flip showing physical edge; right face-down. Small label DRAW above and REVEALING below. Not a deep giant boxed tray; no arrows, plus signs or extra control ornaments. Cards same scale as those in hands.
- Leave visible negative space between draw and hands.
- Three vertically stacked player hands below, CENTERED compact fans. Small HAND 1 / HAND 2 / HAND 3 labels above their fan; blackjack totals directly below. Plenty of blank blue table around every bundle and a comfortable vertical gap between rows. NO right-hand numeric boxes, no full-width gold separators or bounding boxes.
 HAND 1 exactly SEVEN cards: A hearts, A spades, 2 hearts, 2 diamonds, 3 clubs, 4 spades, 5 diamonds. Total 18. All seven rank-and-suit index strips exposed.
 HAND 2 exactly FIVE cards: 2 clubs, 3 diamonds, 4 hearts, 5 spades, 6 clubs. Total 20.
 HAND 3 exactly SIX cards: A diamonds, 2 spades, 3 hearts, 4 diamonds, 4 clubs, 5 hearts. Total 19.
- Physical controls below glass, STAND temporarily dark during draw reveal.

IMPORTANT aesthetic: economical scale and deliberate whitespace, simple clean petrol-blue table surface. Worn chunky textures belong mainly on cabinet shell; make the interior less noisy. Big open margins around compact card fans. Avoid heavy chrome, gold outlines, large panel frames, dense ornamental divisions, enormous suits and oversized cards. Keep the cabinet filling frame; do not zoom camera out to make room. This is a materially smaller and more tightly overlapped card design inside the same close cabinet.
